title: Explore your users’ perspectives
speech: You built an app. Now explore it through your users’ different perspectives. With Journey Lab, create AI personas inspired by your users, give them a task, and follow their journeys through your app. Compare their experiences. Discover what helps, what frustrates, and what to improve.

title: Define a perspective and a task
speech: Define each persona’s goals, knowledge, expectations, and constraints. Choose a task and the conditions you want to explore. Powered by Meta’s Muse Wonder, the persona navigates your app while Journey Lab records its actions, reactions, and progress toward the goal.

title: Connect your app · Meet Gather
speech: Connect Journey Lab to your own app and explore the journeys that matter to your users. To show you how it works, we created Gather, a sample room-booking app. Let’s follow different AI personas as they try to make a booking—and see what Journey Lab helps us discover about their experiences.

title: Different perspectives, different experiences
speech: Alex and Maya both need a room for twelve people. Alex prioritizes speed and has a three-hundred-fifty-dollar budget. Maya has a strict two-hundred-fifty-dollar limit. A quicker booking flow helps Alex. But Maya discovers the full price only at review. She changes rooms, and her meeting name disappears. She eventually books successfully, but has to repeat work along the way.

title: Investigate the evidence
speech: Journey Lab connects each finding to the moment behind it. Click a point on the emotional arc to inspect the AI persona’s reaction and jump to the recording. Compare journeys side by side. Switch perspectives. See where the experience becomes easier, where friction appears, and what changed between versions.

title: Improve and retest
speech: Those findings can become a proposed improvement. Meta’s Muse Code prepares a candidate for review: show the full price earlier and preserve entered details. Then Journey Lab runs fresh journeys against both versions. In this recorded comparison, Maya completes her booking in six actions instead of twelve, while Alex keeps his quick path. Your team can inspect the code, review the evidence, and decide what to ship.

title: Your product. Your journeys.
speech: Gather is one example. Your product has its own journeys to investigate. For developers, designers, and product teams, Journey Lab helps surface friction earlier, identify opportunities, and test improvements from different perspectives. These AI journeys give your team better questions to validate with real people. Journey Lab. One product. Many journeys.
